findings.title: Public file-request upload buffers up to 25 MB per request before validating the token, with no per-token limiter
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a5: POST /file-requests/public/:token/upload mounts multer.memoryStorage() with a 25MiB fileSize limit (routes/file-requests.ts:63-78) as route middleware before the handler validates the token, status, expiry, per-request size and MIME (:122-158). The route is unauthenticated and the only throttle is the global per-IP limiter (app.ts:118-131, 300 requests/15min) — there is no per-token or upload-specific limiter. At 300 x 25MiB that is 7.5GiB of buffering per IP per window before any token check; concurrent requests can exhaust the API container heap without a valid token. Fix: validate the token row in a lightweight middleware before multer, add a per-token/IP upload limiter, and either stream to Storage or lower the buffer cap.
